what: Number reel slot machine — pressing the start button makes the reel at each digit of the chosen value (such as a year in a timeline) spin down, holding five sets of 0–9, starting from three sets above. Each digit starts .15s later, runs (1.3 + .25 × digit index)s ease-out overshooting by 10% of the cell height, then springs back into place in .16s ease-out. While spinning, the button is locked and the element gets is-spinning, and when all reels stop, fx:result(detail.value) fires — the consumer opens that year’s story modal.

options.values: List of values to draw (comma-separated), if empty, any digits to fill the slots
options.each: Extra turn length per spot (ms), default 250
options.[data-fx-part=reel]: Reel cell (child) — height of one digit
options.[data-fx-part=start]: Start button (child) — if none, sends fx:spin to the element to make it spin

note: The original crops the numbers from one background image by horizontal position — here each cell is written as text

from.where: history.html .am-slot (timeline slot — original history_slot: 5 sets of 50 cells, 1 rest set, 3 spin sets, 150ms interval, 1300 + 250·i ms ease-out, 10% overshoot, 160ms bounce, when all stop the year’s GLightbox modal)
